shots.name: deadped
shots.js: const g=__G.game; const c=g.peds.list.find(p=>!p.dead); c.kill(1); __G.step(40); [c.proto, c.dead, !!c.deathA, g.state(), __G.city.trees.length, __G.city.palms.length]
